'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[ADF insurgency]]
**[[Uganda]] launches [[airstrike]]s against [[Allied Democratic Forces]] and [[Islamic State – Central Africa Province]] positions in eastern [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/uganda-launches-joint-strikes-congo-adf-rebels-81463119 (ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[England]] begins to implement [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mandatory mask wearing]] in shops, banks, post offices and hairdressers, as well as on public transport as part of targeted measures to reduce the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/29/covid-as-rules-on-mask-wearing-in-england-return-what-exactly-is-the-law (''The Guardian'')]
*****[[Nottingham]] reports its second case of the Omicron variant in a student who attends the [[University of Nottingham]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-nottinghamshire-59473270 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****The [[Executive Council of Andorra]] announces the closure of nightlife after midnight, the reintroduction of the mandatory wearing of face masks outdoors for those over 6 years of age, and the reduction of capacity at sporting events, gyms, stores, spas, churches, recreational sites and public transport. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/11/30/govern_anuncia_noves_restriccions_sanitaries_191290_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Greece]]
*****The [[government of Greece|government]] announces that anyone over the age of 60 who is not vaccinated will face a monthly fine of [[Euro|€]]100 beginning on January 16. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1172783/greece-plans-fine-for-unvaccinated-over-60/ (''Kathimerini'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
***[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Japan]] closes its border to all newly arrived foreigners and requires its citizens to [[quarantine]] on arrival from countries where cases of the Omicron variant have been detected due to fears of the variant. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-11-29/japan-to-shut-borders-to-foreign-visitors-on-omicron-ntv-says (Bloomberg News)]
***Japan reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a man in his 30s who travelled from [[Namibia]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/first-omicron-case-detected-in-japan (Radio France Internationale)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports its first "preliminary" cases of the Omicron variant in two people who travelled from [[South Africa]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/brazil-reports-two-preliminary-omicron-cases-01638306007 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Réunion]]
***[[Réunion]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a 53-year-old man who travelled from [[Mozambique]] on November 19. [https://www.voanews.com/a/first-french-omicron-case-on-indian-ocean-island-of-reunion/6333249.html (Voice of America)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]], [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
***[[BioNTech]] [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Uğur Şahin]] and [[Pfizer]] CEO [[Albert Bourla]] both say that [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|their vaccine]] is likely to be effective against severe disease resulting from the Omicron variant. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/biontech-ceo-says-current-vaccine-likely-protect-against-severe-covid-omicron-2021-11-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Oxford High School shooting]]
**Four students are killed and seven others injured in a [[mass shooting]] [[school shooting|at a high school]] in [[Oxford, Michigan]], [[United States]]. [https://www.freep.com/story/news/local/michigan/oakland/2021/11/30/oxford-high-school-active-shooter-victims/8810588002/ (''Detroit Free Press'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Philippine presidential election]]
**[[Bong Go]] withdraws his candidacy from the [[president of the Philippines|presidential]] election, stating that he is waiting for "a sign from God". [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/812746/bong-go-drops-presidential-run-in-eleksyon-2022/story/ (GMA Network)]
*[[Republicanism in Barbados]]
**[[Sandra Mason|Dame Sandra Mason]] is inaugurated as the first [[president of Barbados]], as the country becomes the 34th [[republic in the Commonwealth of Nations]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/nov/30/queen-congratulates-barbados-as-it-becomes-a-republic (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021 Honduran general election]]
**The ruling [[centrism|centre]]-[[right-wing politics|right]] [[National Party of Honduras|National Party]] concedes victory to [[leftist]] [[Xiomara Castro]], marking a return for the left to power after Castro's husband [[Manuel Zelaya]] was overthrown in a [[2009 Honduran coup d'état|2009 coup]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/hondurans-wait-slow-vote-count-triumph-leftist-candidate-2021-11-30/ (Reuters)]
